## FAQs

**What is NWSL+?**

-   NWSL+ is a digital streaming service that gives fans access to live NWSL games, match recaps, and highlights. It's a free service available online, and on the NWSL+ app on Apple TV, Fire TV, and Roku. Learn more [here](https://www.nwslsoccer.com/plus).

**Can I stream CBS games on Paramount+?**

-   CBS games can be watched on your local CBS affiliate (over-the-air or via cable/satellite). Streaming on [Paramount+](https://www.paramountplus.com/) is only available on the **Paramount+ with SHOWTIME (Premium)** plan. The cheaper Paramount+ Essentials plan does not include live local CBS streams, and unlike past seasons, no matches are streaming-only on Paramount+.

**What is the Roku Sports Channel?**

-   The Roku Sports Channel is the NWSL's exclusive streaming home for eight Sunday night matches from August 30 through October 25, 2026, with 25 Sunday night matches coming in 2027.
-   It's free through [The Roku Channel](https://therokuchannel.roku.com/), with no subscription required. You don't need a Roku device: The Roku Channel is available on Roku devices and TVs, online at [TheRokuChannel.com](https://therokuchannel.roku.com/), on iOS and Android, and on Amazon Fire TV, Samsung TVs, Google TVs, and other Android TV devices.
-   More information can be found in the [NWSL's announcement](https://www.nwslsoccer.com/news/nwsl-and-roku-expand-partnership-with-sunday-night-streaming-package).
